title: I Did It! & Helping Others Succeed

scenes.t: {name} reads about Tamer. Tamer studied hard every day for his math exam.
On the exam day, he felt nervous. Then, he answered all the questions.
Later, the teacher told him that he got full marks. Tamer felt very proud and happy.
He celebrated with his family at home. They clapped, smiled, and said, 'Well done!' It was a great day.
Yara is a fast runner. She practices every day at the school field.
One day, her friend needed help getting ready for a race. Yara showed her how to run and practice. They ran together every day.
On race day, her friend ran well and smiled. Yara felt happy. They both celebrated their success with big cheers.
